item.title: 🤝 Your courage will live for ages Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation/Chief of the Main Military and Political Directorate of the Russian Armed Forces, General of
item.description: Your courage will live for ages 🤝 Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation/Chief of the Main Military and Political Directorate of the Russian Armed Forces, General of the Army Viktor Goremykin presented awards to participants of the special military operation undergoing treatment and rehabilitation, as well as medical personnel of the military hospital in Volgograd. 💬 On behalf of Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov, General of the Army Viktor Goremykin conveyed words of gratitude to the servicemen. 'Congratulations on the deserved combat awards, I thank you for your loyalty to the military duty, the oath and Russia,' said the Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation. ▫️ For personal achievements in the recovery and rehabilitation of participants of the special military operation, doctors and medical staff of the hospital received medals 'For Help and Mercy'. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📍 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29228

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
The Sever Group of Forces improved its tactical situation.
Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an airmobile brigade of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade near Ulanovo, Khoten, and Kiyanitsa of Sumy region.
💥
In Kharkov region,
strikes were delivered at formations of a mechanised brigade, a motorised infantry brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, and three territorial defence brigades close to Khotomlya, Kotovka, Polnaya, Goptovka, and Prikolotnoye (Kharkov region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 205 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 12 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, one anti-aircraft missile system, two electronic warfare stations, and an Israeli-made RADA RPS-42 counter-fire radar station.
↗️
The Zapad Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group’s units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades of the AFU and a territorial defence brigade near Krymki, Sidorovo, Bogorodichnoye, Prishib of the Donetsk People's Republic, and Chervony Oskol of Kharkov region.
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to over than 210 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 16 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
🚩
As
a result of intensive actions, the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces liberated Kurtovka of the Donetsk People's Republic.
💥
Russian troops hit
formations of five mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade, an airmobile brigade, a mountain assault brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades near Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Druzhkovka, and Verolyubovka of the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The enemy lost more than 205 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 16 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns, including one U.S.-made 155-mm Paladin self-propelled artillery system.
📍
The Tsentr Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, a jaeger brigade, an assault brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, a marine brigade, and three national guard brigades close to Novovodyanoye, Andreyevka, Novogrishino, and Dobropolye of the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 425 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, and one U.S.-made M777 howitzer.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a group strike using high‑precision ground‑based weapons and long‑range attack unmanned aerial vehicles agains
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a group strike using high‑precision ground‑based weapons and long‑range attack unmanned aerial vehicles against metallurgical plants in the Dnepropetrovsk region that supply military defence enterprises, as well as against logistics centres and power substations in the city of Nikolayev, Nikolayev and Odessa regions. 📍 In Dnepropetrovsk region, the following facilities were damaged: ▪️ the Dneprodzerzhinsk metallurgical plant ('Kametstal') and the Dnepr metallurgical plant (Dnepr Metallurgical Plant), which are the largest suppliers of metal components for Ukraine’s military production. 📍 In Nikolayev and Nikolayev region, the following were hit: ▪️ a logistics center used to store military property, and the Nikolayevskay power substation. 📍 In Odessa region, the following were hit: ▪️ in the settlement of Dachnoye – a logistics center used to store military goods; ▪️ in the port of Chernomorsk, a dry cargo ship carrying weapons and military equipment for the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 📍 On the evening of 4 September, the following facilities were hit in Kiev region: ▪️ the Svyatopetrovsky logistics center, which was used to store military equipment; ▪️ two fuel storage and distribution sites for the Armed Forces of Ukraine in the military town of Blistavitsa, near the Gostomel airfield. 📍 In addition, a radio and radio‑technical intelligence center was hit in settlement of Brovary. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a group strike using high‑precision ground‑based weapons and long‑range attack unmanned aerial vehicles against
metallurgical plants in the Dnepropetrovsk region that supply military defence enterprises, as well as against logistics centres and power substations in the city of Nikolayev, Nikolayev and Odessa regions.
📍
In Dnepropetrovsk region, the following facilities were damaged:
▪️
the Dneprodzerzhinsk metallurgical plant ('Kametstal') and the Dnepr metallurgical plant (Dnepr Metallurgical Plant), which are the largest suppliers of metal components for Ukraine’s military production.
📍
In Nikolayev and Nikolayev region, the following were hit:
▪️
a logistics center used to store military property, and the Nikolayevskay power substation.
📍
In Odessa region, the following were hit:
▪️
in the settlement of Dachnoye – a logistics center used to store military goods;
▪️
in the port of Chernomorsk, a dry cargo ship carrying weapons and military equipment for the Armed Forces of Ukraine.
📍
On the evening of 4 September, the following facilities were hit in Kiev region:
▪️
the Svyatopetrovsky logistics center, which was used to store military equipment;
▪️
two fuel storage and distribution sites for the Armed Forces of Ukraine in the military town of Blistavitsa, near the Gostomel airfield.
📍
In addition, a radio and radio‑technical intelligence center
was hit in settlement of Brovary.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
